title: 2026 United States House of Representatives Election for Illinois's 12th Congressional District
description: The 2026 general election for Illinois' 12th Congressional District pits incumbent Republican Rep. Mike Bost against Democratic challenger Julie Fortier. The district covers 34 counties across southern Illinois, from the Metro East region near St. Louis to the state's southern tip, and is rated R+22 by the Cook Political Report, making it one of the most Republican-leaning districts in Illinois. Bost, first elected in 2014 and serving as Chairman of the House Veterans' Affairs Committee, seeks a seventh term on a platform focused on veterans' issues, agriculture, and conservative fiscal policies. Fortier, a biomedical research scientist and U.S. Air Force veteran running as a political newcomer, emphasizes healthcare access, constituent accountability (including holding in-person town halls), and opposition to tariffs she argues harm the district's agricultural economy.
polling_note: No publicly available opinion polls were found for the Illinois 12th Congressional District general election as of mid-2026.

candidates.name: Mike Bost
candidates.summary: Mike Bost is the incumbent U.S. Representative for Illinois' 12th Congressional District, first elected in 2014. He serves as Chairman of the House Committee on Veterans' Affairs and also sits on the Agriculture and Transportation & Infrastructure Committees. A Marine Corps veteran and former firefighter and small business owner, Bost previously served 20 years in the Illinois House of Representatives and is known for his conservative voting record and focus on agricultural and veterans' issues.

candidates.name: Julie Fortier
candidates.summary: Julie Fortier is the Democratic nominee for U.S. House in Illinois' 12th Congressional District. She is a biomedical research scientist with a PhD in Research Pathology, a U.S. Air Force veteran who served during Desert Shield, and a longtime resident of O'Fallon, Illinois. Fortier is running as a political newcomer on a platform of healthcare access as a human right, affordability for working families, opposition to tariffs she argues harm farmers, and pledge to hold regular in-person town halls for constituent accountability.
